raw_segments.text: In one respect, however, the majority of both sexes resemble and equally show a want of
Ignorant women, forced to be chased to preserve their reputation, allow their imagination
to revel in the unnatural and meretricious scenes sketched by the novel writers of the
day, sliding as insipid the sober dignity and matronly grace of history, whilst men
carry the same vitiated taste into life and fly for amusement to the wanton from the unsung
sophisticated charms of virtue and the grave respectability of sense.
